Take the Arrogance of Chaos, overlooking sentient beings from the sky
advancement.enigmaticaddons:ChaosExplosi: Strike the ground with Chaos Pride and kill 10 monsters at once
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.artificial_fl: In the nameless ruins, this beautiful little flower caught your attention. When you haven't figured out why such a beautiful flower grows in the chest, its touch tells you that it is actually an artificial creation.<br2/>Artificial flowers rich in magic can transform materials into various effects of unknown origin.

They are like children who have just entered the world and find it difficult to distinguish the quality of the effects, only knowing to give them blindly.<br2/>In addition, if there are some similar accessories on the body, this cute flower may be even happier.
Looking at all the etherium tools, it seems that none of them can reach the enemies hovering above your head, so it's time to think about how powerful astral dust really is.<br2/>Using the Etherium Sword as the base, extending the handle, sharpening the spearhead, and finally injecting the magic of astral dust, a special spear is born.

The power of astral dust converged at the spearhead, allowing the spear to interact with energy in space. Thus, it can perceive and track every target. And it also can store energy, quickly pierce through and pour out energy, producing
a astral explosion.<br2/>Astral dust has also alienated its enchanting ability, why not try some enchantments that do not belong to swords?

<&n><&8>Notes of enchantments:<&8>
Sharpness
- Increase the damage of throwing spear.Piercing
- Increase piercing times and slightly improve tracking capability.
Since the Heart of Abyss is in hand, why not set your gaze on the sky?<br2/>Based on the same process as the Majestic Elytra, using more evil and powerful materials can obtain these stronger elytra. Soar in the sky with the power of the cosmic and the ender, to look down upon the creatures crawling on the ground.
When we descend from the sky to the ground, chaos and evil will accompany us, bringing impact to the ground and putting everything in chaos.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.disaster_swor: With a sturdy blade and a soul poised to take off, this sword showcases the skills of defense and counterattack.<br2/>Holding this broadsword, you can use its wide blade to block almost all attacks. Given its heaviness, any attack becomes indistinguishable, but you can only lift the sword for a moment.
Whenever successfully blocked, the energy absorbed will linger on the sword, waiting for the perfect release in the next attack.<br2/>The rhythm of disaster gradually emerged in this crisp sound.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.dragon_bow.pa: Given the role of Dragon Breath in brewing, when the potion poured onto the surface of the bow, they are gradually absorbed and merged into the transformed arrows, but its capacity was limited.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.evil_dagger.p: A mysterious weapon crafted from Nefarious Ingot, with endless evil thoughts gathered at the tip of the blade, greedily waiting for the soul to feast.<br2/>As its name suggests, The Curse Carver is able to imprint a unique curse on your soul. Once this indelible curse begins to take effect, the cage of evil thoughts will bind your

actions and hurt your soul bite by bite until they are satisfied. For targets with outstanding vitality, their greedy nature leads them to demand more. When satisfied, they begin to tear apart your soul, pouring out from within

as if trying to completely destroy this useless container.<br2/>In addition, they will no longer look at containers that have already been enjoyed, so this curse has a fatal weakness, which is disposable.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.extradimensio: Although Eye of Extradimension is a good transportation tool for entity, it is still too cumbersome as a disposable item. Can we use materials from the Nether to make new tools? A brand new scepter was born!<br2/>We can now directly teleport creatures into the extradimension exclusive to the scepter, or block many targets in the extradimension
and gradually tear them apart during battles.<br2/>Of course, these operations have a drawback of requiring the target to be sufficiently weak in terms of vitality relative to oneself.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.frost_enchant: Frost Shattering - Enhanced the frost breaking ability of the axe, increased critical damage to fully frozen targets, and continued the freezing effect. It cannot be combined with Fire Aspect.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.illusion_lant: In a corner of the Nether, this lamp flickers with a faint light, and you can feel countless vengeful souls lingering around.<br2/>Although there was soul fire burning, it never felt the temperature inside, and even felt a chill emanating from it. So this magic stone will allow you to blend into the environment of the undead,

while also being more sensitive to brightness.<br2/>The overlapping of virtuality and reality also gives you higher resistance to penetrating damage, allowing you to divide the virtual shadow possession and share the damage. But does this soul lantern exist, perhaps all of this is just your imagination?
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.quartz_scepte: The same material but different recipe gave birth to a brand new scepter. Using the magic of materials to transform into a dagger and thrust forward, although the power is not very strong, it is at least a non consumable means.<br2/>In addition, in the Nether, it is inevitable that objects will fall and burn, so this scepter, with its ability to absorb
items, can show off its skills in certain situations.<br2/>Given the magical power of magic quartz, similar items can have a certain impact. Why not try wearing a Magic Quartz Ring and compare it.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.redemption_cu: These curses attached to armor are one of the trials from the path of redemption.<br2/>This curse will amplify the damage you receive. But after you complete the redemption ceremony, these curses will transform into blessings from redemption, providing you with damage resistance.
And due to its unique curse method, the Redemption Curse is incompatible with other curses, so it can be said that it can protect your armor from other curses.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.scorched_char: To purify the power of flames, in addition to protection, we also need more auxiliary abilities.<br2/>Unlike Frost Walker, this charm allows you to walk directly on lava without the need to transform it into other strange objects, making it easier for you to travel in the Nether.

In addition, with the power of ichor, this charm has awakened some blessings from ancient times, which can turn the heat in lava into the driving force of life. And the blessing itself seems to be called the 'Seven Suns'.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.totem_of_mali: We have no idea about how the illagers created totems of undying, but behind each totem there must be sacrifices of living beings.<br2/>But now, using the nefarious essence to release the malice of these sealed souls, mobilizing their anger towards illagers, to fulfill their final desire for revenge.
As their wish for revenge has been fulfilled, they will not forget their duty. They are still willing to protect you in the most dangerous moments and release themselves to attack the enemies around.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.violence_scro: In the endless slaughter, the pleasure brought by violence makes you linger. And the Scroll of Thousand Curses has extended an invitation to you, allowing you to carry the power of the curse and reach the peak together with the abyss.<br2/>Faced with the thirst for violence, the more we fight, the braver and crazier we
become, constantly counterattacking in the midst of injury, and unleashing the accumulated anger.
As an upgrade of the Thousand Curses and the Devoured Malignancy, this object still holds a thirst for the curse. Please satisfy it, it will not mistreat you.
